title: Premium Content Blocks
text:
## Premium Content Blocks
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000082844
Brilliant Directories’ Web Page Builder has tools just like Microsoft Word, and included are 10+ basic content Pre-made Elements (text with images, videos, buttons, forms, etc.) that can be applied by dragging and dropping into the builder to quickly compose a web page.
Now there are premium elements available with even more creative and modern designs available with the Premium Content Blocks. This add-on offers not just blocks of elements, but also fully designed content areas ready to be customized.
Websites with the VIP A.-Ons Club automatically have this add-on available: Join The VIP Add-Ons Club
Purchase Individually: Premium Content Blocks Add-on

## Enabling the Add-On
This add-on will be available to use under the Content >> Edit Web Pages section :
Click " Edit " for an existing page OR click New Web Page + button to create a new web page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12099211744/original/JdjrrOoCvf4XsO57IZ2nx4xj1IZYpsBBsw.png?1633573249 | alt: ]
Once on the web page, look for the "Pre-Made Elements" section on the right sidebar:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12099209855/original/jrsco_nOz03bwERFatSm82sb0ZUrR9ULTA.jpeg?1633565452 | alt: ]
The Premium Blocks will display below the default Pre-Made Elements, scroll down to find them.
There are more than 25 flexible & modern content layouts which are classfied under:
Call to Action – 8 blocks
Features List – 8 blocks
Team Members List – 5 blocks
Standard Content – 9 blocks
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12099211304/original/5rHCqK6AnyIul39RKVj6zej90fcMdn3b5A.gif?1633571503 | alt: ]
To start using one of the blocks simply drag-and-drop the block into the static page:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12099210035/original/BUzv9HkQl_AQX9I3lnd5XOoKlVD9jTNEqA.gif?1633566397 | alt: ]
Easily customize and edit the elements by using the FROALA Editor options:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12099211451/original/4tg96C5j8bGqpjlc9v-Ad2F1LrMsTK6Tvg.gif?1633572167 | alt: ]
